h1: What are Newton's SR and MR zoning districts?
title: Newton Zoning Districts Explained: SR1, SR2, SR3, MR1–MR4
description: What Newton's Single Residence (SR1–SR3) and Multi-Residence (MR1–MR4) districts are and which housing types the ordinance allows in each.
short_answer: Newton's ordinance sets up Single Residence 1, 2 and 3 districts and Multi-Residence 1 through 4 districts. Detached single-family homes are permitted in all of them. Detached two-family homes are permitted in MR1–MR4 but not in SR1–SR3.

facts.text: The ordinance establishes Single Residence 1, 2 and 3 and Multi-Residence 1, 2, 3 and 4 districts (Sec. 1.3.1).
Detached single-family housing: permitted in SR1–SR3 and MR1–MR4.
Detached two-family housing: not allowed in SR1–SR3; permitted in MR1–MR4.
Multi-family dwellings: not allowed in SR1–SR3 or MR1; special permit in MR2–MR4.

qa.q: Can I build a two-family house in an SR district?
qa.a: The use table marks detached two-family housing as not allowed in SR1–SR3.
By special permit in MR2–MR4. They are not allowed in SR1–SR3 or MR1.
